title: Native Local Metadata
script: Welcome to this deep dive into Native Local Metadata. Part of PaperPilot's native Document Operations suite, this tool provides deterministic, local-first execution. Engineered entirely in pure Rust, it operates with zero cloud egress, giving you complete data privacy, no SaaS subscription fees, and no external API rate limits. Now let us examine the input parameters and what each signifies. You configure input, an required parameter for Path to the input PDF file.. In addition, title, an optional parameter for Optional new PDF title to write.. In addition, author, an optional parameter for Optional new PDF author to write.. In addition, subject, an optional parameter for Optional new PDF subject to write.. In addition, keywords, an optional parameter for Optional new PDF keywords to write.. Every parameter is rigorously validated in memory before processing begins, ensuring safe, predictable transformations across all your documents. Next, output files and metrics. The tool emits optimized .pdf documents at Optional destination .pdf path; when provided, writes updated metadata to disk.. By pruning redundant objects, deduplicating font streams, and applying memory-safe Rayon parallelism, it slashes document file size by up to eighty percent in under fifteen milliseconds, with zero bytes leaked to the cloud. You can deploy pdf_metadata across all five universal interfaces. First, drag and drop in the desktop dock for live inspection. Second, call it autonomously from Claude or AI agents through our native Model Context Protocol server. Third, run it directly in your terminal with the PaperPilot CLI. Fourth, trigger it via local REST API POST requests at localhost port 8080. And fifth, execute it client-side in your browser with zero-upload WebAssembly. Unlock total document privacy and native performance today. Visit usepaperpilot.com to explore pdf_metadata and all one hundred tools, run live interactive benchmarks, and download the bare-metal binary. Local-first document intelligence, powered by PaperPilot.
